approvedConvention: Preserve existing namespace; use stable semantic camelCase suffixes; keep dynamic values as parameters; share only when owner, consumer and parameter contract match.
rationale: The source consumer is one carousel. Repeated page titles and navigation labels use the same purpose and parameter contract. Previous/next tooltips remain separate. Four collapse/action labels reuse matching keys already assigned to the same component's initialization path.
limitations: Proposal only; no product or canonical index mutation.
The index still reports these occurrences unkeyed until reconciliation.
Visual/accessibility approval and extraction are outside this proposal.
